case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your quick and clear offer for the SH-220 shaft. We appreciate your practical approach and would like to work with you on this part.

To be transparent, we have a competing offer on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To award the order to you, we need to close that gap. Each of the following options is a genuine path to an agreement. Option C keeps your current payment term unchanged, so nothing changes on your cash side:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Please let us know which option works best for you, and we can move forward quickly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your quick and well-prepared quotation for the SH-220 stainless shaft, and for your clear interest in a long-term partnership. We share that interest.

To award this part, we need commercial terms that work for us, including delivery to our site rather than ex works. We have therefore prepared three options for you to consider:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

Each option is a genuine route to an award. Option B keeps your current payment terms, and Option A gives you a higher price against a longer payment term.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. To help you out against the other offer, I can drop the price to 15.70 EUR for this setup. We can do the DAP delivery you asked for in Option C. Hallo, as a small shop we need the cash to keep the machines running, so we have to stick to 30 days payment. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We have carefully reviewed your options, but providing DAP delivery and a 35-day lead time adds significant freight and expedited production costs compared to our initial offer.
To best support your cost targets, we propose maintaining EXW delivery and a 45-day lead time, which allows us to reduce our price to €15.50.
If DAP delivery is strictly required for this award, please let us know and we will provide a revised offer that incorporates the necessary logistics costs.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
